headline: PHI @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 2.74 at LAD 3.57, with a projected total of 6.31. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (PHI -0.73, LAD -0.67), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -1.41, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jesús Luzardo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Brandon Marsh, Teoscar Hernández, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Bryce Harper because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
